title: Balanced Forces and Inertia
summary: Resultant force, friction, and Newton's first law: objects keep doing what they're doing unless a resultant force acts.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 6: How Forces Affect Motion
Earlier NCERT: Force and Laws of Motion

objectives: I can find the resultant of forces acting along a line.
I can state Newton's first law and explain inertia.
I can explain how friction affects motion.
misconceptions: A moving object needs a force to keep it moving.
If an object is not moving, no forces act on it.
Heavier objects have no more inertia than light ones.
